results.bounded_claim: spontaneous SIGABRT/SIGKILL exit-shape classification on Linux headless Godot 4.7.2 only; signal origin unprovable from returncode

Linux headless Godot 4.7.2 POSIX pipe semantics: communicate(timeout) is a completion+pipe-drain bound, timeout kill is direct-child-only, descendants orphan; not a Windows/macOS or exported-build claim

signature presence over merged captured output is origin-blind: a descendant's post-child-exit write of the expected signature satisfies it; accepted (verdict PASS) whenever the pipes release before the bound, separable only via the timed_out/child_exit_at_timeout evidence when held past it — documented forgery-accepting boundary, not a fix; Linux headless Godot 4.7.2 POSIX pipe semantics only

a poll()-gated signature read accepts the expected marker only when observed while the direct child is alive: genuine child signatures (default and detached-descendant arms) were observed while-live in every rep; reparenting-gated forged signatures (--spawn-forge-release/--spawn-forge-hold) arrived after observed child death in every rep and were rejected though present — on this fixture the gate discriminates forged post-death writes from genuine writes; not a claim that observation-time liveness proves authorship in general (a pre-death-scheduled or faster-racing forge is out of scope); Linux headless Godot 4.7.2 POSIX semantics only

the un-allowlisted-ERROR rejection axis is as origin-blind as the signature axis: a reparenting-gated descendant's post-death error write lands in the merged capture and flips a clean exit-0 + signature-present record to FAIL, byte-identical in classification-visible fields to the child-authored push_error control, separable only by the r63-style provenance lines (banner/spawned_pid/write_ppid) and write timing; the r64 while-live gate does NOT reject the forged-error arm — its criterion is the signature marker only, so the genuine while-live signature is accepted and the post-death error is gate-invisible, though the gated read does record the error arriving only after observed child death; Linux headless Godot 4.7.2 POSIX pipe semantics only

results.bounded_claim: the rejection clause's verdict is a pure function of merged-output line presence modulo the per-case allowlist — measured forgeable in both directions by a post-death descendant on this fixture: (a) a forged error matching the allowlist is verdict-inert (absorbed) while the identical captured bytes reject under () and under a foreign entry; (b) exact/, -prefix/count==1/structured entry shapes all gate as declared incl. tail-forge count==2 defeats; (c) ERR\n+OR: newline-split EVADES the line-local scan while a stdout-tail+stderr-head seam FABRICATES a reject line present in neither stream, and a pre-death mid-signature splice fabricates an error line AND destroys the signature substring (dual-clause corruption); (d) dead-entry census over expected_errors carried as data, self-validated by the real classifier; Linux headless Godot 4.7.2 POSIX pipe semantics only
